trans.cn: Bản thân (dùng trong những lời khen ngợi tự ti); chính tôi (được sử dụng trên cuống vé, séc, v.v., để chỉ người giữ hoặc người ký)
trans.cn_source: 自己（用于自谑的赞美语中）；本人（用于票根、支票等，指称持有人或签署人）

trans.cn: (danh từ) (Self) (English) Self (tên)
trans.cn_source: 【名】 （Self）（英）塞尔夫（人名）

sentences.c: He has no self-confidence.
sentences.cn: 他毫无自信。

sentences.c: Dishonesty is ultimately self-defeating.
sentences.cn: 不诚实最终将会自食其果。

sentences.c: He was inclined to self-pity.
sentences.cn: 他总是自哀自怜。

trans.cn: ích kỷ, tư lợi
trans.cn_source: 自私的，利己的

sentences.c: She calls me lazy and selfish.
sentences.cn: 她说我又懒又自私。

sentences.c: 'Isn't that a bit selfish?' he chided.
sentences.cn: “那不有点自私吗？”他责备道。

sentences.c: Do you think I'm being selfish by not letting her go?
sentences.cn: 你觉得我不让她走是自私吗？
